body:
Well, according to the [docs](https://symfony.com/doc/current/components/serializer.html#handling-circular-references), you should use `setCircularReferenceHandler()`. So, there's a mismatch between the code and the docs. One of them contains a bug.

And then there's the 'circular_reference_handler' config option in the FrameworkBundle, which is passed to the `setCircularReferenceHandler()` method. So, there's another bug there.
We need to update the docs and fix the code.
